snippet.title: Road to Empress II Goes Global on June 9th!
snippet.description:
The gates of destiny are opening once more. This time, your journey begins as a nun at Ganye Temple, and your goal is the throne of absolute power!
Use your wisdom and strategy to survive the palace of blades and prevail in the court of shifting loyalties.
Step by step, claim the empress throne and usher in your own golden age!

⬇ Tap to pre-register Road to Empress II:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4148240?utm_source=YouTube&utm_campaign=522
